SYMPTOM: Fork implements supersession logic but it silently fails for project memories in 3 specific ways.

BUG 1 — superseded_by not set on project memories:
`updateMemory()` in store.ts doesn't support the `superseded_by` field. When `storeCurationResult()` tries to link the old memory back to the new one, the field is silently dropped. Global memories work (have `updateGlobalMemory()`), project memories don't.

BUG 2 — ID parsing doesn't strip brackets:
Curator might output `"[#abc123]"` in supersedes field. The parser only strips `#` not `[#...]` brackets. Will fail silently — memory is extracted, supersedes reference is malformed, old memory never gets marked superseded.

BUG 3 — Rule 3 (shared-tags linking) logs success but no-ops for project memories:
`linkedCount++` runs even when the `related_to` update is skipped for project memories. Logs say "linked" but nothing actually links.

ADDITIONAL (non-critical):
- `this._config.projectPath` doesn't exist on type — latent crash
- Cross-segment dedup headlines have no IDs so can't be superseded, only skipped
- Ingest race condition: gets new IDs by re-querying recent memories instead of collecting from storeMemory return values
- Stray console.log in store.ts
- `replace` should be `replaceAll` in temporal class validator

FIX: All in /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/memory — being fixed in separate Claude session.
